# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Checklist

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, credentials, private keys, real project logs, or customer data are included.
- [ ] Documentation was added or updated when behavior changed.
- [ ] Eval case or demo was added/updated if a rule, skill, command, or governance behavior changed.
- [ ] Validation was run with `python scripts/validate-open-source-package.py`.
- [ ] Screenshots or GIFs are included if this changes UI, diagrams, or demo presentation.
- [ ] Breaking changes are listed below, or this PR has no breaking changes.

## Breaking Changes

List breaking changes, migration steps, or write "None".

## Validation

Paste validation commands and results. Do not include secrets or real project logs.
